indications_and_usage: Uses For the temporary relief of symptoms associated with indigestion fatigue following meals occasional headaches Directions Adults and adolescents (12 years and older) Take 5 drops three times daily or as recommended by your healthcare practitioner. Children (under 12 years) Take under the direction of your healthcare practitioner.
